title: Prescriptions Training Note: Statuses from Received to Closed
content:
A record under Kestrel Prescriptions moves between the statuses received, active, expired, transferred out and discontinued according to the rule below.

## The rule

- A prescription becomes **active** when its original fill is dispensed, and returns to **received** only when that original fill is returned to stock.
- It **expires** on the day after its expiration date whether or not refills remain; an expired prescription is never refilled and the patient is offered a renewal request.
- It is **discontinued** when the prescriber sends a cancellation, when the patient asks Kestrel to stop filling it, or when a newer prescription for the same drug and strength replaces it under the Prescriptions same-drug replacement standard.
- A prescription with a fill still in will-call is not discontinued until that fill is picked up or returned to stock.
- Expiry, discontinuation and transfer out each end any refill-program enrollment on the prescription under the refill charter.
- None of these closures refunds a fill already picked up.

## Status map

| From | To | What brings it about |
|---|---|---|
| received | active | the original fill is dispensed |
| active | received | the original fill is returned to stock |
| received or active | expired | the day after the expiration date arrives |
| received or active | transferred out | a transfer to a pharmacy outside Kestrel |
| received or active | discontinued | prescriber cancellation, patient request, or replacement by a newer prescription for the same drug and strength |

## Training questions

**A prescription's expiration date is a hypothetical day 180 and it still has 2 refills.** It expires on day 181; the remaining refills do not keep it open, and the patient is offered a renewal request.

**The patient asks to stop a prescription while a fill sits in will-call.** It is not discontinued until that fill is picked up or returned to stock.

**Does discontinuing a prescription refund the last fill the patient collected?** No. None of these closures refunds a fill already picked up.
